setName: Egyptian God Deck: Obelisk the Tormentor

Super Rare.name: Angel O1
Super Rare.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by revealing 1 Level 7 or higher monster from your hand. You can only Special Summon "Angel O1" once per turn this way. While you control this Special Summoned card, you can Tribute Summon 1 Level 7 or higher monster in Attack Position during your Main Phase, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

Super Rare.name: Harpie's Feather Duster
Super Rare.desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.

Super Rare.name: Level Resist Wall
Super Rare.desc: If a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: Target 1 of those monsters; Special Summon monster(s) from your Deck in Defense Position so their combined Levels equal the Level of that monster, but negate their effects. You can only activate 1 "Level Resist Wall" per turn.

Super Rare.name: Mare Mare
Super Rare.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned, except by the effect of a Wyrm-Type monster. During your Main Phase: You can reduce this card's Level by 1, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Mini Mare Mare Token" (Wyrm-Type/WATER/Level 1/ATK 300/DEF 200). You can only use this effect of "Mare Mare" up to thrice per turn.

Common.name: Bazoo the Soul-Eater
Common.desc: Once per turn: You can banish up to 3 monsters from your Graveyard; this card gains 300 ATK for each, until the end of your opponent's turn.

Common.name: Brain Control
Common.desc: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.

Common.name: Call of the Haunted
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Common.name: Cloning
Common.desc: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons a monster that has a Level: Target that face-up monster; Special Summon 1 "Clone Token", with the same original Type, Attribute, Level, ATK, and DEF as that target. When that target is destroyed and sent to the GY, destroy this Token.

Common.name: Condemned Witch
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can add 1 "Forbidden" Quick-Play Spell from your Deck to your hand. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 Level 4 Fairy monster from your Deck, except "Condemned Witch". You can only use each effect of "Condemned Witch" once per turn.

Common.name: Cyber Dragon
Common.desc: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

Common.name: Different Dimension Capsule
Common.desc: Select 1 card from your Deck and remove it from play face-down. During your 2nd Standby Phase after activation, destroy this card and add the removed card to your hand.

Common.name: Double Summon
Common.desc: You can conduct 2 Normal Summons/Sets this turn, not just 1.

Common.name: Drowning Mirror Force
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: Shuffle all your opponent's Attack Position monsters into the Deck.

Common.name: Evilswarm Mandragora
Common.desc: If your opponent controls more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

Common.name: Evilswarm Salamandra
Common.desc: Up to twice per turn: You can banish 1 monster from your Graveyard; this card gains 300 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn.

Common.name: Forbidden Chalice
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; until the end of this turn, that target gains 400 ATK, but its effects are negated.

Common.name: Forbidden Dress
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; until the end of this turn, that target loses 600 ATK, but cannot be targeted or destroyed by other card effects.

Common.name: Forbidden Lance
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; until the end of this turn, that target loses 800 ATK, but is unaffected by the effects of other Spells/Traps.

Common.name: Gizmek Makami, the Ferocious Fanged Fortress
Common.desc: While 6 or more of your cards are banished, you can Normal Summon this card without Tributing. You can only use each of the following effects of "Gizmek Makami, the Ferocious Fanged Fortress" once per turn. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can discard 1 monster; add 1 monster whose ATK equals its own DEF from your Deck to your hand, except "Gizmek Makami, the Ferocious Fanged Fortress". If this card in the Monster Zone is destroyed: You can shuffle 6 of your banished cards into the Deck.

Common.name: Gizmek Uka, the Festive Fox of Fecundity
Common.desc:
Each time your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s): Inflict 300 damage to them. You can only use each of the following effects of "Gizmek Uka, the Festive Fox of Fecundity" once per turn.
● If a monster(s) is Special Summoned from the Main Deck (except during the Damage Step): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
● If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; Special Summon 1 monster from your hand or Deck whose ATK equals its own DEF, with a same Attribute as that monster.

Common.name: Hardened Armed Dragon
Common.desc:
(This card is not treated as an "Armed Dragon" card.)
You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 1 Level 8 or higher monster from your hand to the Graveyard. If you Tribute this card for the Tribute Summon of a Level 7 or higher monster, that monster cannot be destroyed by card effects.

Common.name: Monster Reborn
Common.desc: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it.

Common.name: Nimble Beaver
Common.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower "Nimble" monster from your Deck or GY.

Common.name: Nimble Momonga
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Gain 1000 Life Points, then you can Special Summon any number of "Nimble Momongas" from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Common.name: Photon Sabre Tiger
Common.desc: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 "Photon Sabre Tiger" from your Deck to your hand. If you do not control another "Photon Sabre Tiger", this card loses 800 ATK.

Common.name: Pot of Avarice
Common.desc: Target 5 monsters in your GY; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Ra's Disciple
Common.desc: When this card is Summoned: You can Special Summon up to 2 "Ra's Disciple" from your hand and/or Deck. Cannot be Tributed, except for the Tribute Summon of "Slifer the Sky Dragon", "Obelisk the Tormentor", or "The Winged Dragon of Ra". You cannot Special Summon monsters, except by the effect of "Ra's Disciple".

Common.name: Super-Nimble Mega Hamster
Common.desc: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Beast-Type monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Common.name: Supply Squad
Common.desc: Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: Draw 1 card.

Common.name: The Monarchs Stormforth
Common.desc: Once during this turn, if you would Tribute a monster for a Tribute Summon, you can Tribute 1 monster your opponent controls even though you do not control it. You can only activate 1 "The Monarchs Stormforth" per turn. During the turn you activate this card, you cannot Special Summon monsters from the Extra Deck.

Common.name: Unmasked Dragon
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 Wyrm-Type monster with 1500 or less DEF from your Deck.

Ultra Rare.name: Divine Evolution
Ultra Rare.desc:
This card's activation and effect cannot be negated. Choose 1 monster you control whose original Type is Divine-Beast or whose original name is "The Wicked Avatar", "The Wicked Dreadroot", or "The Wicked Eraser", except a monster(s) already affected by "Divine Evolution", and it gains 1000 ATK/DEF, its effect activations and its activated effects cannot be negated, also it gains the following effect.
● When this card declares an attack: You can make your opponent send 1 monster they control to the GY (their choice).

Ultra Rare.name: Fist of Fate
Ultra Rare.desc:
This card's activation and effect cannot be negated. If you control a monster whose original name is "Obelisk the Tormentor": Negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls, and if you do, destroy it, and if you do that, for the rest of this turn, the effects of that monster are negated, as well as the activated effects and effects on the field of monsters with the same original name, then, if you activated this card during your Main Phase, you can apply this effect.
● Destroy all Spells and Traps your opponent controls.
You can only activate 1 "Fist of Fate" per turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Obelisk the Tormentor
Ultra Rare.desc: Requires 3 Tributes to Normal Summon (cannot be Normal Set). This card's Normal Summon cannot be negated. When Normal Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. Neither player can target this card with card effects. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned: Send it to the GY. You can Tribute 2 monsters; destroy all monsters your opponent controls. This card cannot declare an attack the turn this effect is activated.

Ultra Rare.name: Soul Crossing
Ultra Rare.desc:
During the Main Phase: Immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon 1 Divine-Beast monster. When you do, you can Tribute a monster(s) your opponent controls, even though you do not control them, but if you Tribute Summon this way, apply this effect.
● Until the end of the next turn after this card resolves, you can only activate 1 card or effect per turn, not counting the effects of Divine-Beast monsters.
You can only activate 1 "Soul Crossing" per turn.
